verdict.rationale: Hardware support is a fair axis for any operating system, so the story applies, but no evidence shows macOS can be installed on non-Apple hardware of the user's choosing. The documentation centers on Macs and Apple-device Continuity features, and 'Run Windows on your Mac' runs the other direction. A passing community mention of a Hackintosh is an unofficial user-side workaround, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install and use the OS without vendor lock-in on hardware of my choosing
